new_theorem.name: QFORM-NULL-HUB-UNION-GRAPH-RECEIVER-v1
new_theorem.hypothesis_summary: In the designated partner exact-rank-three single-null-hub state, let C=S disjoint_union Y disjoint_union Z satisfy rho_S M_2(G_Y,G_Z)>=(2/81)rho. Put T=Y disjoint_union Z and tau_T^2=dist(t_T,col(Y_T))^2. If tau_T=0, condition only on S and any additional exact r-collinear original coordinates.
new_theorem.regularity: essential boundedness only; continuity not proved by this endpoint argument
new_theorem.provenance: X_0 is an untouched original coordinate independent of the whole dependent two-dimensional projection P_T on the disjoint original bank T; no post-rotation independence or conditional-cap substitution

required_source_application.inequality: for signature (2,1), ess sup_{s>=0} p_Q(s)<=pi sqrt(2), sign reversed for (1,2)

route_counterexample.name: QFORM-THREEBANK-PACKET-PUNCTURED-INNOVATION-FAMILY-v1
route_counterexample.summary: For even m>=8, an exact Parseval frame with h=1-1/m and M_0=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] has exact target spectrum {-1,1,1}. A valid S/Y/Z partition has M_2=9/16, rho_S=1/m-1/m^2, det(G_Y+G_Z)=9/16, but tau_T=1/m>0 tends to zero. All nonhub row norms squared are <=1/m, scalar pivots are O(1/m), pair determinants O(1/m), and principal triples O(1/m^2).
route_counterexample.meaning: The partner packet alone does not imply tau_T=0 or a universal positive innovation gap. This is a route counterexample, not a counterexample to QFORM.

first_unpaid_detail: Prove one universal essential density bound on the convex/two-sheet side for tau_T>0 uniformly as tau_T downarrow0, retaining the disjoint original-coordinate banks X_0,S,Y,Z before projection collapse; no perturbative deletion, worst conditional projection-density supremum, or conditional-cap-as-independence step.
